title: First Clearing
tutorialTip: Welcome to PuzzleTown! Every Tree must have a Woodcutter orthogonally next to it, and every Woodcutter must have a House next to it. Numbers show how many more buildings are needed!

title: Fertile Soil
tutorialTip: New Building — Farm: Every Woodcutter AND Farm must have a House orthogonally next to it. A House can sit between both to satisfy both!

title: Founding the Hall
tutorialTip: New Building — Town Hall & Roads: Town Hall requires its 8 surrounding squares to be clear of buildings, trees, and rocks! Woodcutters and Farms connect to it via Roads.
